en: Back from a long journey? Rest and relax at the Pig and Whistle!
Gelkak's key slides into the vacant slot.
We must first craft a prison to confine the beast, if you wish to progress further.
If you have been muted, or have questions about the Muting/UnMuting process, please visit...zzzzttt!!
Mine! Mine! Mine!  Gizlock is the ruler of this domain!  You shall never reveal my presence!
%s reignites from the heat of another Core Hound!
Where in the Outlands are those shipments? For days they keep me waiting!

Zul'jin shall return one day, $r. Mark my words. Until then, we all hold our positions and do what we can to keep the forest troll population intact.$B$BWith that said, as master huntsman of Revantusk Village, it is my responsibility to insure that the world around us is safe for habitation.$B$BThe beasts of this area must be kept in check.$B$BAre you looking for work?
May I help you locate something, citizen?
Well met, $c.  You want some advice?  Befriend a mage!  We have a trick or two up our sleeves, we do...
Nope, can't help you, I'm afraid. Your skills have mine beat! If you want to learn more, talk to the night elf Telonis in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus. He's amazing!
We've done it! We won!
Sounds kinda like one of Billy's fish stories to me.
Greetings, $c. I am Leoren, stable master of Cenarion Hold.
Tower Point holds the pass between the Field of Strife and the Horde territories to the south.$B$BIt is controlled by the Alliance.
Thank you, good $c.
%s bows before Krang Stonehoof

All the roguish types hang out in The Forlorn Cavern, north of the gates of Ironforge.  I'd wager ye'll find Fenthwick there, no doubt counting the coin of another cut purse.  I'll catch him one of these days!  

In the meantime I'll have my eye on you as well, $glad : lass;.
Stand at attention, soldier!$B$BWINKY! SOUND OFF!
There you go...
Your fate is sealed, Deliana!  You will pay for your trespasses against Lord Valthalak!
Upgrade to veteran units!
Do you hear the call of the hunt, $c?  You must listen closely, but the call comes from deep within you.  It comes from deep within all of us.
Where did you think the Wind Rider Master would be?  Head to the top of The Sky Tower in the Valley of Strength!
What? You mean you can't kill this one by yourself?
You think you can summon us? We are the ones that summon, not you! We bash you good for this and suck the marrow from your bones!

Do you require an illusion?$B$BShould your illusion falter in the midst of your quest, return to me and I shall reapply the guise.$B$BShould you fail in your endeavors, do not give up! Return to me. I shall assist you until you have completed your objectives.
Into the box me pretties! Thas it. One by one ye go.
Bah! Failed again!
Teaching is not a one-sided trade, $n. As I teach you, I learn more myself, and my understanding grows.
Rin'ji will tell you secret now... $n should go to the Overlook Cliffs. Rin'ji hid something on island there.
Hello, Rutgar. The Commander has sent me here to gather some information about his missing wife.
I have lost my Hammer of the Gathering Storm. Are you able to replace it for me?
Ticket redemption here!  Get your tickets turned into prizes!  Step right up!
Not now.  Have you any tasks for me?

Welcome to the Great Forge $g lad : lass;. It may be cold outside but we keep it nice and hot down 'ere. Grab a hammer, strike that anvil and show me ye've got what it takes to be a Blacksmith of the Great Forge!
Oh, I'm sorry, but you know more about leather than I do at this point. Talk to Faldron over there if you wish to learn more.
%s becomes enraged from seeing a cub die!
You!  Enter the fray!
Greetings, friend! I have ample supply of leather and hides, and I know a few techniques I might be willing to share. Interested in doing business?
Your gods can't save you now, $c.

A little bit of a lot of things. Mostly I take the soft and weak and reshape them into hardened fighters once again.

It's a tough world out there, and even our own people mistrust us. We need to be tough and self-reliant if we are to fit into this "horde" with the rest of our people.
